Like for like (the review of F6a, finding 8): the dialog is the Board Series page's own DatesForm, so the same five fields cost the same five inputs; what the header saves is the page change and the academic-year filter (one input), not the dates. The first run (11 Oct) typed two dates and the reason (3 inputs) and is not comparable with the baseline's six; the like-for-like run typed the baseline's five fields: 5 inputs and 2 clicks, no page change, against 6 inputs, 2 clicks and a page change.
